h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Kakinada

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Kakinada

c: Kakinada is a port on the Bay of Bengal, and the cyclones that come in from the sea shape how we fix outdoor gym machines here. FunPlay Systems supplies Fun Fitness outdoor gym equipment to schools, colleges, port and industrial colonies, housing layouts and municipal parks in Kakinada. The machines are made at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,020 km away, and travel to the Godavari coast by road.

Strong winds test the fixing more than the machine itself. On open coastal ground we recommend grouted bases, set in concrete, rather than self-standing ones. The air is humid and salty for most of the year, so the frames are galvanised and the seats roto-moulded. Our team or a dealer in south India does the installation. Send us photos of the site and tell us how exposed it is to the sea wind.

items.q: How are outdoor gym machines fixed on the coast?
items.a: We recommend grouted bases set in concrete on open coastal ground. They hold the machine firmly in strong winds. The layout drawing shows each footing.

items.q: Does salt air damage the machines?
items.a: Salt is hard on bare steel, which is why our frames are galvanised. Rinse the machines with fresh water from time to time and check moving parts regularly.

items.q: What should we check after a cyclone?
items.a: Check that every bolt is tight, that no part is loose or bent, and that the ground around the bases is firm. Call our after-sales team if any part is damaged.
